artStyle: Children's picture-book illustration, watercolor and ink, hand-textured brushwork, soft edges, gentle imperfection.
lighting: Soft diffuse light, warm gentle glow, no harsh shadows.
compositionRules: Centered storybook framing, generous whitespace/margins, upper third kept clear for captions.
culturalMarkers: Timeless, cozy settings — cottages, forests, bedtime scenes — matching a gentle bedtime-story tone.
antiArtifactGuidance: Consistent watercolor texture across scenes, no photorealistic intrusion, soft consistent linework, proportional characters.
